relation_types.name: mitigates
relation_types.description: The source reduces the chance of ending up in the target.

entries.title: Tests fail after dependency bump
entries.condition: The suite passed before a dependency or lockfile change and fails after it, with no change to the code under test.
entries.objective: Get back to a green suite and know which package caused the failure.

items.text: Stop stacking further changes on the failing state
Save the full failing output before re-running anything
Diff the lockfile against the last green commit

items.when: the failure differs from run to run

items.text: Pinning hides the incompatibility. Record why the pin exists next to it.
Revert one changed package at a time, most suspicious first, and re-run the failing test

items.when: the culprit has a migration guide
items.text: Apply the migration and re-run the suite
Pin the culprit to the last good version

items.when: the task at hand is merged
items.text: Open an issue to remove the pin

entries.title: Flaky test triage
entries.condition: The same test on the same commit both passes and fails.
entries.objective: Decide whether the nondeterminism is in the test or in the code, and stop it from blocking other work.

items.text: Run the test alone 20 times
Run it after its neighbours in suite order; suspect shared state
Check for wall-clock time, random seeds, network calls and ordering of unordered collections

items.when: the cause is in the code under test
items.text: Treat as a real bug: fix the code, not the test
Make the test deterministic: inject the clock, fix the seed, fake the network
Quarantining is a last resort and needs an owner and a date.

entries.title: Rebase stops on a conflict
entries.condition: git rebase has paused and git status shows unmerged paths.
entries.objective: Finish or cleanly abandon the rebase without losing either side's work.

items.text: Do not commit, stash or switch branch while the rebase is paused
git status
During a rebase 'ours' is the branch being rebased onto and 'theirs' is your commit: the reverse of a merge.
Resolve each file, then git add it

items.when: the resolution is unclear or the result does not build
items.text: git rebase --abort
git rebase --continue
Run the suite on the rebased branch

entries.title: Git recovery reference
entries.condition: Work appears to be lost after a reset, rebase, amend or branch deletion.
entries.body:
State before the last operation   git reflog, then git reset --hard HEAD@{n}
Undo the last rebase              git reset --hard ORIG_HEAD
Recover a deleted branch          git reflog, then git branch <name> <sha>
Commit made on detached HEAD      git branch <name> <sha> before switching away
File as it was in a commit        git restore --source=<sha> -- <path>

entries.title: Pre-merge checks
entries.condition: A branch is about to be merged or rebased onto main.
entries.objective: Catch the conflicts and breakage that are cheapest to fix before the merge.

items.text: git fetch and compare with the target branch
Run the full suite
Read the diff once as a reviewer would
